note: WAEC Marketing round 3 (Round 21 top-up): marketing concept eras (product, selling, marketing, societal), 4Ps and 7Ps, STP, SMART and AIDA, mass vs niche marketing, skimming vs penetration vs odd vs cost-plus vs bundle pricing, brand name vs trade mark, packaging protection, product life cycle stages, segmentation bases (demographic, psychographic, behavioural), perceptual maps, positioning, channel levels, agents' commission, supermarket vs departmental vs chain vs mail-order retail, warehousing and transport modes, coupons, premiums, loyalty schemes, radio vs billboard media choice, publicity vs advertising, word-of-mouth, rational vs emotional motives, consumer rights and the FCCPC, annual-plan control, marketing audit, forecasting, test marketing, CRM and sponsorship. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-2, NECO Commerce/Marketing and the JAMB pool.
